title: Saudi Arabian Linguine with Warm Crispy Sauce
description: A fusion dish blending the flavors of Arabic cuisine with the simplicity of Italian linguine. The warm crispy sauce brings a satisfying crunch to the dish.

ingredients.name: warm crispy sauce (see below for recipe)

instructions: Cook linguine according to package instructions until al dente.
In a large skillet, heat the warm crispy sauce over medium heat.
Add crushed garlic to the sauce and sauté for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Add cooked linguine to the sauce and toss to combine.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Garnish with chopped parsley and lemon juice.
